hypothesis: If fishes have neither hearing organs nor smell organs and no passages for either sense, the zebrafish adult anatomy will contain none of the pre-registered hearing or olfactory structures.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. A pass would require the zebrafish anatomy file, treated as a complete inventory, to lack every pre-registered adult term. Because a missing string is not evidence of anatomical absence, this test does not pass on absence. The claim is supported only if the file is downloaded and a positive statement in it says these structures do not occur. No such statement is expected from a presence ontology; if it is absent, absence of terms yields inconclusive, not support.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. The claim is refuted if any pre-registered adult term is present. Hearing terms, exact name or synonym: inner ear; otolith organ. Smell terms: peripheral olfactory organ; olfactory epithelium; olfactory rosette. Passages: olfactory pit; naris; nostril; olfactory nerve; octaval nerve. The claim says fishes lack both senses, so one sense's organ is enough to refute it. If none of these strings match and the file does not positively deny them, the verdict is inconclusive with reason not-operationalizable. If the file cannot be downloaded, inconclusive with reason data-unavailable.
interpretation: Aristotle says fishes lack the organs of hearing and smell and any passages for them. External ear flaps are not required. The inner ear is scored as a hearing organ and the peripheral olfactory organ, olfactory epithelium or olfactory rosette as a smell organ. Olfactory pit, naris, nostril and the named nerves are passages. The test species is Danio rerio, a fish. One fish with either organ refutes the universal.

test_contract.expected_observation: The zebrafish adult anatomy would have to state that hearing and olfactory organs and their passages are absent.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: Any pre-registered adult hearing, olfactory or passage term is present.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: A public anatomy ontology of a fish, with stage information so embryonic-only structures can be set aside, licensed for reuse and independent of Aristotle.
test_contract.inference_method: Exact name or synonym match against the pre-registered list, kept only when the term's end stage is adult. Presence refutes. Absence of a string does not support.

caveats: While checking URLs, ZFIN term pages and a search snippet named the inner ear and the peripheral olfactory organ. The verdict still comes from a count of the downloaded files.
Zebrafish is one fish. Presence refutes a universal; it does not describe every fish.
method: Downloaded the ZFIN anatomy term file, synonyms and stage table. Counted exact names or synonyms in the pre-registered hearing and smell list whose end stage is the adult stage. Any such term refutes the claim that fishes lack those organs and passages. A missing string does not count as absence.

datasets.name: ZFIN zebrafish anatomy terms, synonyms and stages

measured.unit: pre-registered adult hearing or smell terms present in zebrafish
measured.uncertainty: exact name match against the pre-registered list
